Ragi and Coconut Sheera   Ingredients:  1 Tbsp spoon Ragi 1 Tbsp dessicated coconut 1 Tsp ghee Water Jaggery powder according to taste Almonds for garnishing. Method: Roast Ragi powderwithout ghee in an iron pot for 4-5 minutes till it changes colour. Once done add coconut and ghee and roast for 2 more minutes. Add boiling water as per your likeable consistency and let it boil. Then add little jaggery powder and dish out. Serve with Almonds on top.  Enjoy and sleep nice after this.#ragi #coconut #lowiron #bettersleep #dinner
